description: Source code for managing group addition of objects in a data model, including creation, rollback, and parameter setting functions.

methods.name: GROUP_ADD_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes a group add vector structure by setting its vector to NULL and number of entries to 0.

methods.name: GROUP_ADD_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Frees all memory used by the group add vector, including paths, error messages, unique keys, and parameters.

methods.name: GROUP_ADD_VECTOR_AddObjectToCreate
methods.description: Adds a new object creation request to the group add vector with specified request path, response path, and group ID.

methods.name: GROUP_ADD_VECTOR_AddParamSetting
methods.description: Adds a parameter setting to the last object in the group add vector.

methods.name: GROUP_ADD_VECTOR_CreateObject
methods.description: Creates an object using either vendor hook or internal data model, handling parameter validation and error reporting.

methods.name: CreateObject_WithCreateVendorHook
methods.description: Creates an object via vendor-specific callback, validating parameters and permissions.

methods.name: CreateObject_WithoutCreateVendorHook
methods.description: Creates an object directly via data model API, setting parameters and validating unique keys.

methods.name: RollbackGroupAddEntry
methods.description: Deletes an object instance if owned by a data model provider, used for rollback.
